title: Bright Vision - Training & Learning Management Platform
tagline: Digital educational portal and management platform built for Bright Vision Training Center students and instructors.
shortDescription: Web-based learning and administration portal enabling student enrollment, course material access, attendance tracking, and lab exercise evaluations.
problemStatement: Bright Vision Training Center required a cohesive digital system to streamline student enrollment across computer literacy and programming tracks, track practical lab sessions, and distribute lecture materials without relying on manual paper spreadsheets.
role: Computer Trainer & Lead Developer — Architected the student registration workflows, course directory, attendance verification modules, and curriculum portal.
architecture: Engineered with React, Next.js, and TypeScript with a clean component-driven architecture. Uses Tailwind CSS for high readability in laboratory environments and responsive layouts across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
features: Student enrollment and cohort onboarding directory
Interactive course module catalog with downloadable exercises and assignments
Instructor dashboard for verifying lab attendance and grading practical projects
Responsive, clean UI optimized for local training lab workstations and mobile devices

title: InzuHub - Smart Real Estate & Housing Platform
tagline: Modern digital housing and property network connecting Rwandan house hunters, property managers, and tenants.
shortDescription: Web-based real estate portal for discovering rental properties, houses, and land in Rwanda with intuitive filtering and direct landlord connections.
problemStatement: Finding verified rental housing, residential apartments, and commercial spaces across Kigali often relies on informal broker networks with high middleman commissions, outdated listings, and lack of transparent pricing.
role: Lead Full-Stack Developer — Architecting the property catalog, search/filter algorithms, responsive user interface, and property listing management workflows.
architecture: Engineered as a high-performance modern web application with Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Features category-based property queries, neighborhood geo-filtering, dynamic image galleries for listings, and direct contact actions.
features: Interactive property filtering by district, price range, bedrooms, and amenities
Verified listing cards with high-resolution photo galleries and rental terms
Direct WhatsApp and call integration to connect prospective tenants with landlords
Responsive mobile-first layout optimized for low-bandwidth cellular connections

title: ZoraShop Rwanda - Online Marketplace
tagline: Consumer e-commerce platform built for Rwandan shoppers with localized product discovery.
shortDescription: Responsive online retail platform featuring categorized product catalogs, shopping cart management, and streamlined checkout.
problemStatement: Rwandan consumers needed a fast, accessible digital retail site allowing them to browse products, view details in Rwandan Francs (RWF), and place orders with minimal data consumption.
role: Creator & Lead Developer — Created the digital storefront, catalog structure, cart state, and order messaging system.
architecture: Optimized responsive web platform built for high speed and accessibility over mobile networks, deployed at zorashoprwanda.infinityfreeapp.com.
features: Instant product discovery across consumer and tech categories
Shopping cart with real-time total calculation
Mobile-optimized browsing designed for Rwandan smartphone users
Direct ordering integration and contact options
